args.title: Triage issue 4426
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Ledgerline stores transaction amounts as exact integer minor units (bigint) in the database rather than floating-point numbers. Currencies with no minor unit (such as the Japanese Yen, JPY) are tracked with 0 decimal places via minorDigits() and stored directly as whole units.

args.title: Triage issue 4434
args.body:
File: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

In src/components/UploadForm.tsx, the onChange handler for the file input updates the selected file via setFile(e.target.files?.[0] ?? null), but it does not clear the previous upload error (setProblem(null)). As a result, the old upload error stays on screen after picking a different file until the user submits again.
